name: Sock line
summary: The laundry room's lost and found as a clothesline of orphan socks with googly eyes: tap a sock to see where it turned up, say it's yours, and when you're its only claimer take it home and it hops off the line; two claimers on one sock is a dispute and it wiggles nervously until someone lets go.
useWhen: whose socks are these in the laundry room
lost and found for the apartment
someone left a sock in the dryer again
who owns the giant grey sock
sort out the random laundry nobody claimed
dontUseWhen: tracking washers that are running now (use washer-watch)
borrowed things to give back (use gear-wall)

sub.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'laundry room lost and found'

socks.description: Up to 8 socks on the line: pattern, colour, size (1 small, 2 normal, 3 enormous), where it was found, who already claims it, and an optional quoted line like 'Calvin: that's my sock'

gone.description: Names of friends who already took a sock home
